commonContract: Preserve the existing bone entries/index order, constraints, stops and motion; any new hem bones/physics append without changing common entries.
preserveAttachments: Approved face, eye, brow, mouth, ear and hair attachments/images, including accepted rearhair completion.

newSourceParts.name: topwear
newSourceParts.source: Source-backed camisole from the new topwear layer; contour and chest influence regions authored on the new silhouette.
newSourceParts.binding: Existing chest/hip and unchanged boob_r/boob_l anchors; accepted coefficients remain unchanged.

newSourceParts.name: cardigan
newSourceParts.source: Actual new knitted cardigan; separate source pixels/silhouette from camisole where the extracted layer permits.
newSourceParts.binding: Chest/hip base; optional new small hem chains only after actual garment anchors are measured. Do not repurpose the old skirt chains.

newSourceParts.name: hands
newSourceParts.source: New source clasped hands, separated from cardigan sleeves and the topwear base.
newSourceParts.binding: Chest foreground, outside bust influence. Refuse duplicated hand stamping or an unfilled base if hands move away.

newSourceParts.name: neck
newSourceParts.source: New source-backed exposed neck/chest skin; never carry old white shirt collar into the lower neckline.
newSourceParts.binding: Measured new boundary joined to unchanged accepted head/face. Existing neck attachment may be replaced explicitly.

newSourceParts.name: bottomwear
newSourceParts.source: New pyjama trousers, not the old pencil-skirt geometry.
newSourceParts.binding: Hip-centred first. Narrow cuffs receive no inferred old-skirt physics.

newSourceParts.name: shoes
newSourceParts.source: New slippers with their source soles; exclude ground reflection verified in slipper-alpha-contact.
newSourceParts.binding: Existing root/hip rest-space frame; retain exact visible pose.

newSourceParts.name: sleeves
newSourceParts.source: Sleeve portion of real full:handwear-l split at the actual clasped-hand wrist boundary
newSourceParts.binding: Existing chest only; no bust/hem influence

holes: Use real See-through hidden pixels if valid. Any necessary generated hidden repair must use the image-generation tool and retain its provenance; never invent hidden pixels with an alpha/paint heuristic.
reference: Registered original clothing pixels plus the approved head/face, independently assembled as the intended source reference; a flattened candidate is not a source-fidelity oracle.
validation: Public layer/parts readers for real manifests
Named official rigc build and parts check; no gate bypass
Actual rest/idle/wind/moved-release visual and mesh-fold evidence, with any remaining limitation stated separately

cardiganHems.physics: Separate appended constraints; common29 constraints remain exact, including unused old skirt constraints
